from forte2 import AVAS, CISolver, MCOptimizer, RHF, State, System

xyz = """
N 0.0000000000 0.0000000000 0.0000000000
N 0.0000000000 0.0000000000 1.2000000000
"""

system = System(
    xyz=xyz,
    basis_set="cc-pvdz",
    auxiliary_basis_set="def2-universal-jkfit",
    minao_basis_set="cc-pvtz-minao",
)

rhf = RHF(charge=0)(system)

avas = AVAS(
    subspace=["N(2p)"],
    selection_method="separate",
    num_active_docc=3,
    num_active_uocc=3,
    diagonalize=True,
)(rhf)

ci_solver = CISolver(State(nel=rhf.nel, multiplicity=1, ms=0.0))
mc = MCOptimizer(ci_solver)(avas)
mc.run()
